channel.title: DEML Blue Notes
channel.description: Field log of DEML platform releases, architecture, and operator capabilities.

item.title: Viking-UI 7.0.0 operational dashboard components
item.description: The seventh major Viking-UI release adds Cloudscape-inspired operational components: split-panel, flashbar, property-filter, collection-preferences, form-template, chart-container, and enhanced table primitives.

item.title: Viking-UI 6.0 interlocks navigation across every DEML surface
item.description: The sixth major Viking-UI release gives the application, marketing site, backend pages, and component docs one shared authentication-aware navigation contract.

item.title: Analytics exports via FORJD
item.description: Export jobs are tenant-scoped and executed in FORJD; DEML exposes them through the BFF.

item.title: FORJD owns the streaming hot path
item.description: DEML stays the control plane; FORJD’s Rust engine runs sealed pipeline and data-plane roles.

item.title: Temporal forecasting arrives across the platform
item.description: A Norse spiking-neural-network forecaster moved from training infrastructure into live tenant-scoped status, analytics, and dashboard experiences.

item.title: Projection health on the status surface
item.description: Platform status reflects FORJD readiness and sealed projection availability through the Django BFF.

item.title: The first release train: content, prediction, and security controls
item.description: The v0 release series connected the public content system, threat prediction, subscriptions, compliance reporting, encryption, and performance work.

item.title: Platform Log 000: The first line of the operating system
item.description: DEML began as an open technical book and grew into a working platform for telemetry, predictive operations, and cybersecurity engineering.

item.title: ML Models: Temporal Forecasting and Countermeasure Effectiveness Standard
item.description: PyTorch-based machine learning pipeline for predictive analytics including SLA forecasting, threat detection, and temporal spiking neural networks.

item.title: Viking-UI Premium Theme: Dark-First Engineering Aesthetic
item.description: The Viking-UI design system introduces aerospace-inspired dark themes, machined metallic borders, and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across all DEML surfaces.

item.title: Sealed projections through FORJD
item.description: Durable projections and analytics execute in FORJD; DEML adapts product paths through Django.

item.title: Containerized control plane
item.description: Distroless Django and Angular images keep DEML’s user plane portable across hosts.

item.title: DEML architecture: control plane + FORJD
item.description: DEML owns identity and the Angular product; FORJD is the universal secure streaming engine.
